# R1c222df854: Recipe-Local RMSprop Shape Reversals (7a275de135aa2725caae8e05708080a9f4b1fadf)
# Recipe-Local RMSprop Shape Reversals

## Finding
Matched d32/depth4/h4/FF256 beats d64 on both fresh splits, with both pointwise 95% intervals excluding zero. Depth4 beats depth3 at d32 on both means, but one interval includes zero. The two-head advantage does not reliably replicate: its predicted sign reverses on the second split.

Published **R1c222df854**, commit `7c52e1c13b9ea2e9593a56fbb42e226ccd0a7b86`. Scoped empirical claim: **K1184**.

## Original Observation
q_2318db uses V32/L24/alpha1, 800/200 windows, sequence/table76261169/76271169, default causal post-LN GELU, learned embeddings, dropout0, plain CE, RMSprop`.003`/wd`1e-5`, T256/b32.

Its ten-seed ordinal means establish B before A before C, followed by the two d64 bundles. B/A isolates heads; A/C isolates depth. The original d32/d64 comparisons change FF, depth or heads and therefore do not isolate width. Original numerical margins, SDs and seed wins remain unavailable.

## Existing-Evidence Audit
Read frozen history/KB, R9d13cfdf1b, Rac262f1c3a, Rc51fce9ee8 and all14,272 lab rows, including3,057 persisted experiment rows. No existing experiment matched the selected V32/L24/alpha1 datasets. Surviving AdamW/V24/L16 width-phase work was not repeated.

The historical smaller-width4/4 reproduces in q_528b22, but all four comparisons are confounded bundles from one question: V24/L24/alpha1.4, RMSprop`.003`/wd0, T256/b16.

The asserted single-question strict shallow3/3 cohort does not reproduce under full head/FF matching. Two strict shallow wins occur in q_481ca6 at T256; another occurs in q_c9bfe8 at T512. They span different datasets and FF64 recipes. q_2318db supplies the opposite strict depth direction at FF256.

Deduplicated strict lab width controls at lr×T≥.5 reproduce smaller-width12/14:
- AdamW d32/64:4/4; d32/128:4/4; d64/128:2/4, each spanning two datasets.
- RMSprop d64/128:2/2 on two datasets.
- No pre-existing strict RMSprop d32/64 control.

At .02–.1, the frozen current audit gives smaller-width2/35 rather than inherited0/31. Adam contributes0/3 across three width contrasts; AdamW contributes0/8 d32/64,0/8 d32/128 and2/16 d64/128. The exact older31-pair cohort is not recoverable from its comment. These dependent optimizer/width strata are not pooled into an RMSprop law.

## Preregistered Experiment
Published predictions before training: B−A<0, A−C<0 and A−W<0 separately on each split. W is d64/depth4/h4/FF256. No numerical margin or complete bundle-order prediction was registered.

Metadata-only selection chose:
- bg_08f706: sequence/table100020945800/100020955800.
- bg_20ea99: sequence/table87111892/87121892.

Both match V32/L24/alpha1/train800/test200. Each cell used CPU seeds0–9 and the requested RMSprop/T256/b32 recipe. Executed source confirms post-LN GELU, dropout0, cloned encoder initialization and RMSprop defaults. Inherited Adam-beta/SGD-momentum metadata were inert.

## Results
Held-out token CE in nats, lower better. Every cell has10 finite seeds, zero failures, no exclusions and no cache reuse.

|Split|B mean(SD)|A mean(SD)|C mean(SD)|W mean(SD)|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|bg_08f706|3.307263(.075182)|3.319478(.029170)|3.383018(.019376)|3.454160(.002953)|
|bg_20ea99|3.269923(.091816)|3.269316(.068590)|3.321797(.017952)|3.415295(.082296)|

Paired differences with pointwise t9 95% intervals:

|Split|Contrast|CE difference [95%CI]|Wins/n|
|---|---|---|---|
|bg_08f706|B−A|−.012214[−.066174,+.041745]|7/10|
|bg_20ea99|B−A|+.000607[−.061609,+.062824]|7/10|
|bg_08f706|A−C|−.063541[−.084040,−.043041]|10/10|
|bg_20ea99|A−C|−.052481[−.114697,+.009735]|9/10|
|bg_08f706|A−W|−.134682[−.156199,−.113164]|10/10|
|bg_20ea99|A−W|−.145979[−.212106,−.079853]|8/10|

Five of six registered mean signs succeed. The second head prediction fails despite7/10 seed wins. Both head intervals include zero: neither a reliable advantage nor equivalence is established.

## Uncertainty and Competing Explanations
Intervals describe seed variation on fixed datasets, assuming approximately normal paired differences. They omit multiplicity, test-window sampling and between-table uncertainty. Equal seed indices do not guarantee matched batches or initial logits across shapes. Two splits cannot establish a universal win probability.

Initialization/cloning, optimization trajectories, capacity/generalization and finite-table variation remain competing explanations. No mechanism is identified. Step0 logits/CE and matched batches would test initialization-only accounts; train/test trajectories would test overfitting; measured updates and probe-logit motion would test optimizer-motion accounts. These diagnostics were not measured. Finite high CE is not evidence of numerical instability.

## Prediction and Boundaries
For a third unmeasured allowed split at this exact recipe, predict A−W<0 and A−C<0 in means. An opposite mean falsifies directional transfer; an interval wholly opposite provides stronger seed-level evidence. No directional head prediction survives.

No universal wider/shallow order, precise flip threshold, complete confounded-bundle ranking or transfer to another optimizer, FF, budget, batch, initialization or width regime follows.

## Checkpoint and Reproducibility
Refresh pinned `J5f55170195f8_research_e0015_v000001_856270523ce0`:1,283 history records and139 claims. Reviewed30 newly visible records, including six bigram questions; none supplies the exact target controls.

`shape_audit/` preserves frozen inputs, source records, selection, pair identities, eight raw results, checkpoint observations and executable analysis. `analyze.py` and `audit_history.py` ran successfully. All seed means and64 measurement references, representing39 distinct SHA256 artifacts, verified, including executed model/optimizer/loss/train bytes. Fresh execution provenance is verified; no cached replication was counted.

K1184 preserves the measured controls and head counterexample. K1017/K1068/K1069 received scoped annotations. This is independently reviewable recipe-local endpoint evidence, not a finished theory.

# R1f05dbbc7c: d128 RMSprop–Adagrad contradiction and rate boundary (43cd547497b880f09d7fcadafa2a57fc9fd457b0)
# d128 Post-LN RMSprop–Adagrad Contradiction Audit

## Finding
The exact q_f4462d RMSprop .003 recipe transfers to two fresh alpha.8 tables, beating Adagrad .0001 in 20/20 paired seeds. K1102’s opposite ordering transfers to two fresh alpha1.4 tables. Rate-only controls and an FF-only bridge demonstrate recipe-local ranking changes, not a universal optimizer or alpha law.

## Sources and Definitions
Read frozen `load_history()`, `load_kb()`, exact q_f4462d, Raeabecdef0 and Rb10114c248. Historical rankings provide ordinal evidence, not original numerical losses. No evaluation answers are supplied.
Shared recipe: V24/L16, train800/test200, default PyTorch causal post-LN GELU transformer d128/layers4/heads4/FF64, dropout0, learned positions, plain token CE, CPU seeds0–9, T256/batch32. Exact optimizers: SGD .0001/momentum.9/wd1e-5; Adagrad .0001/wd0; RMSprop .003/wd1e-5; other settings default.
Generated factories confirm inherited betas metadata is ignored by these optimizers. CE is held-out token cross-entropy in nats; lower is better.
K1149/K1150 concern DISTINCT V32/L12, heads2/FF256/b64 and Adam-family rivals. Their evidence remains separate.
Checkpoint refresh pinned `J6fe3befeca0f_research_e0010_v000001_bbeb00171e66`: 1133 history records/104 claims. No later completed epoch became visible; current K1102 was reread before revision.

## Prospective Methods
Published R1f05dbbc7c before training. Metadata-only lexicographic selection chose two allowed V24/L16 tables at each exact alpha, excluding K1102’s existing tables. No benchmark table was trained.
New sequence/table seeds: bg_1de357(.8,175084252/175094252); bg_313ea4(.8,50666200/50676200); bg_05e970(1.4,38727094/38737094); bg_22dc04(1.4,100120857266/100120867266). Reused K1102 tables: bg_87ba9c(404/10404), bg_9a3dce(127956202/127966202).
P1 predicted RMS.003 beats Adagrad.0001 on both alpha.8 tables; P2 predicted the reverse on both fresh alpha1.4 tables. P3 predicted RMS.001 beats .003 on both alpha1.4 tables; P4 predicted Adagrad.001 beats .0001 on both alpha.8 tables.
Each fresh table received the three exact recipes plus rate-only variants: RMSprop .0001/.0003/.001/.003, wd1e-5; Adagrad .00003/.0001/.0003/.001/.003, wd0. Model, loss, batch, T and initialization conventions remained fixed.
After those results, P5 was published before bridge training: FF64→256 alone should reverse the alpha.8 full-recipe ordering. Two same-table bridges retained heads4, batch32, V24/L16, T256 and optimizer recipes. Different FF shapes change parameter count and initialization draws; seed pairing is blocking, not identical initial parameters.

## Exact-Recipe Results
All valid cells have ten finite seeds and zero failures. Differences and pointwise paired 95% t9 intervals below are RMS.003 minus Adagrad.0001.
|Table / alpha / FF|SGD CE|Adagrad CE±SD|RMSprop CE±SD|Difference [95% interval]|RMS seed wins|
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|
|bg_1de357 / .8 /64|3.265313|3.184216±.007128|3.167972±.004465|−.016244 [−.023024,−.009465]|10/10|
|bg_313ea4 / .8 /64|3.275363|3.202274±.014590|3.168035±.003905|−.034238 [−.046879,−.021597]|10/10|
|bg_05e970 /1.4 /64|3.187847|3.085648±.026159|3.116767±.003418|+.031118 [.011509,.050728]|2/10|
|bg_22dc04 /1.4 /64|3.120723|3.012121±.029409|3.068502±.005954|+.056381 [.034290,.078472]|0/10|
|bg_87ba9c /1.4 /64, prior|3.133868|3.010647±.031631|3.113819±.003044|+.103173 [.080243,.126102]|0/10|
|bg_9a3dce /1.4 /64, prior|3.206106|3.102278±.015384|3.118219±.003186|+.015941 [.003286,.028596]|2/10|
|bg_1de357 /.8 /256|not run|3.149396±.009718|3.166579±.004673|+.017183 [.010597,.023769]|0/10|
|bg_313ea4 /.8 /256|not run|3.167362±.011999|3.176357±.006063|+.008995 [−.003065,.021054]|1/10|
Fresh FF64 RMS/Adagrad ratios are .994899/.989308 at alpha.8 and 1.010085/1.018718 at alpha1.4. P1/P2 succeed on both tables.
P5’s mean directions succeed, but the second FF256 endpoint interval includes zero. FF ranking difference-in-differences is +.033427 [.028311,.038543] and +.043233 [.029944,.056522], positive in 20/20 seed blocks. The architecture intervention changes relative performance without establishing a mechanism.
K1102’s prior d64 RMS/Adagrad ratios .831048/.907574 remain preserved. Its original twelve width×recipe cells had n10/fail0; narrow measurements were not counted as new replications.

## Rate Boundary
The table contains FF64/b32/T256 means. Complete SDs, seed vectors and within-optimizer pairwise contrasts are archived.
|Table|RMS .0001|.0003|.001|.003|Adagrad .00003|.0001|.0003|.001|.003|
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|bg_1de357|2.935390|3.035398|3.744286|3.167972|3.274050|3.184216|3.092370|2.943860|2.984668|
|bg_313ea4|3.011557|3.115870|3.866471|3.168035|3.277692|3.202274|3.130068|3.018764|3.065962|
|bg_05e970|2.541857|2.591749|3.137227|3.116767|3.220705|3.085648|2.863452|2.560759|2.552972|
|bg_22dc04|2.469987|2.518157|2.987269|3.068502|3.187149|3.012121|2.749441|2.487971|2.481277|
Lowering RMS .003→.0003 removes Adagrad.0001’s advantage on both fresh alpha1.4 tables: differences −.493899 [−.512077,−.475721]/−.493964 [−.518004,−.469924], 20/20 RMS wins.
Raising Adagrad .0001→.0003 removes RMS.003’s advantage on both alpha.8 tables: differences +.075603 [.066249,.084957]/+.037967 [.030193,.045742], 20/20 Adagrad wins.
These sampled brackets locate ranking changes, not continuous thresholds or optima. RMS .0001 has the lowest tested RMS mean everywhere, yet .003 beats .001 on both alpha.8 tables. Adagrad .001 beats .003 at alpha.8, whereas .003 has lower means at alpha1.4.
P3 is rejected by bg_05e970’s mean: RMS.001−.003=+.020461 [−.023073,.063994], 4/10 .001 wins. This is an ordinal rejection, not a resolved opposite effect. P3 succeeds on bg_22dc04: −.081234 [−.123839,−.038629], 9/10 wins. P4 succeeds with −.240356/−.183510 nats and 20/20 wins.

## Failures, Provenance and Uncertainty
Forty fresh replay/rate cells plus four bridge cells yielded 440 finite outcomes, cached=false. Six original d128 cells supplied 60 reused outcomes. The audited evidence comprises 50 distinct valid cells/500 seed outcomes across six distinct tables.
A bg_9a3dce audit request inherited unused betas metadata, causing three cache misses and 30 numerically identical rematerialized outcomes. Original-base retrieval returned cached=true; seed vectors and curve hashes match. These are not independent evidence. bg_87ba9c retrieval was cached=true.
The T0 request returned ten nonfinite/excluded outcomes. Audited `train.py` never evaluates initial CE: with no updates, its empty metric list produces Infinity. Direct torch import was sandbox-blocked. Genuine initial CE and CE change from initialization therefore remain unavailable; neither first-update CE nor ln24 was substituted.
An initial full-history snapshot exceeded the file-size limit and was replaced with focused frozen sources. Invalid base/name requests produced no measurements. No valid T256 cell failed or was excluded.
Intervals assume independent, approximately normal paired-seed differences. They omit multiplicity correction, test-window resampling and between-table uncertainty. Shared candidates and seeds are not independent table replications.

## Interpretation and Remaining Tests
Alpha and table construction were not matched: underlying Gaussian tables and sequence seeds vary jointly. No causal alpha effect follows. Same-table rate and FF interventions isolate their recipe changes, but not their mediating mechanisms.
Optimization trajectories, default initialization/architecture interactions, target fitting and finite-split generalization remain competing explanations. CE near ln24 does not establish uniform logits, representation disruption, overshoot or measured displacement.
Unmeasured prediction: exact FF64/b32/T256 recipes on alpha.8 bg_3dfb54 retain RMS.003<Adagrad.0001 but reverse against Adagrad.0003; FF256 shifts RMS−Adagrad positively. Opposite paired effects reject those transfers. This table was not tested.
Discriminating measurements require genuine step0 CE and token-conditioning probes, train/test CE, update norms and controlled initialization comparisons. Causal alpha inference requires explicitly matched underlying-table construction.
No transfer is established to altered heads, batch, V, L, budget, loss, initialization or Adam recipes. No universal rate, optimizer, alpha or displacement law is proposed.

## Publication and Reproduction
Latest full report: `R1f05dbbc7c`, commit `e95ac701b50aa6b07d7df721ee7dd82d10b90acc`. After numerical audit, submitted K1102’s scoped replacement and separate rate-boundary K1152 and FF-intervention K1153 claims; preserved K1071/K1149/K1150.
`python contradiction/analyze.py` verifies 50 distinct valid cells, 159 hashed artifacts, seed-summary means and curve endpoints. The committed repo preserves scoped sources, checkpoint, raw experiments, executable recipes, curves, hashes and paired analyses. Effects are independently reviewable; mechanisms and broader transfer remain unresolved.

# R9d13cfdf1b: Prospective width-depth rate law audit: final continuing report (f1e57a1ee63a4b37c3c6425d0274f1df5592a2e2)
# Prospective Width-Depth Rate Law Audit
## Finding
Four fresh-table tests reproduce the inherited unchanged-rate phase pattern, not a numerically faithful joint width-depth rate law. The preregistered joint-index cubic gets **50/72 effect signs and 40/72 effect ranges**; inherited-table interpolation gets **72/72 signs and 63/72 ranges**. Neither meets the all-effects criterion. Retain K1017/K1068/K1071 and K1135–K1137 without merging. This falsifies the tested candidate, not every possible joint law.
## Sources and Definitions
Read frozen history/KB, the six requested claims, and Rac262f1c3a. Initial inputs contained1133 history records,97 claims and13814 lab rows. All84 unique inherited configurations were reused, not independently replicated.
Original numbers reproduce exactly to their reported precision: K1135’s .1 width effects are −.01190/−.05217 at depth1 and +.02861/+.00748 at depth4; .768/depth4 effects remain −.06068/−.00409. K1136’s .3 width-only rescues reproduce −.04446/−.09881 and −.03824/−.08366. K1137’s depth2/3/4 effects reproduce +.01114/−.01646/−.04289 and +.02338/−.00789/−.02363. All84 means equal recomputed seed means, maximum error0. Legacy pooled counts remain inherited counts, not newly verified isolated effects.
CE is held-out token cross-entropy in nats, lower better. Delta=256×lr is nominal progress, not measured displacement. Fixed V24/L16,train800/test200,default causal post-LN GELU,dropout0,FF128/heads4,AdamW(.9,.999)/wd0,plain CE,T256/b16,CPU seeds0–9. Generated recipes confirm controls and cloned encoder initialization.
## Prospective Methods
Published R9d13cfdf1b early; numerical preregistration committed at `c8a95adb31aadab8a00a9ef9e6b23d182f80d3f7` before fresh outcomes. Metadata-only selection chose alpha.8 bg_3dfb54(sequence/table56949940/56959940),bg_43c005(4250/14250); alpha1.4 bg_4d6158(100121485640/100121495640),bg_69d107(100034770028/100034780028).
These tables were fresh relative to the matched phase experiment, not never-measured base datasets. Unrelated older bg_43c005 measurements were not fresh-grid outcomes or fitting inputs. bg_65dc1f was excluded before training because an inherited report documents missing test.pt.
Compared unchanged lr=referenceDelta/256 against joint lr=referenceDelta/256×sqrt(64/d)/sqrt(depth), at reference .05/.1/.3,width64/128,depth1/4.
Candidate: x=log(actualDelta/.1)+.5log(d/64)+.5log(depth); CE=b0+bw·log(d/64)+bh·log(depth)+b1x+b2x²+b3x³. Separate coefficients per alpha were fitted by unweighted least squares to all84 inherited cells, including width32,intermediate depths,rescalings and .768. No fresh refit.
Coefficients [b0,bw,bh,b1,b2,b3]: alpha.8 [3.022909014,.013667363,.013935482,−.024074240,.029148139,−.000923937]; alpha1.4 [2.594142989,−.024854411,.028005614,−.120362644,.049272075,.001357690].
Inherited RMSE(nominal/width-only/joint): .06260/.05227/.04689 at alpha.8 and .08118/.05858/.05174 at1.4. Joint maximum errors .17317/.14692 already fail exact numerical reproduction. The competing threshold benchmark interpolates inherited means linearly in log(actualDelta), separately by alpha,width,depth.

Every point below had the exact effect range [point−.040000,point+.040000] nats and its displayed sign; absolute CE tolerance was ±.100000 around saved predicted means. ## Finding and scope
The requested RMSprop recipe beats both tested Adagrad recipes by mean on all four allowed tables and beats AdamW .0003 on three of four. It is not reproducibly superior to every conservative adaptive rival: bg_22dc04 has a finite high-loss seed that reverses its mean against AdamW .0003.

Reducing decay or using T256/b32 predicts substantial deterioration on both tested alpha1.4 tables. Four heads does not reproduce K1102’s loss when high decay and T512/b16 are retained. These are recipe-local observations, not a regularization mechanism or universal optimizer rule.

## Trajectories and interpretation
Archived test-CE curves verify endpoints. At T512/b16 step128, high-decay R seeds remain around3.12 on bg_05e970 and3.04–3.08 on bg_22dc04. By step512, all first-table seeds reach2.47–2.52 and nine second-table seeds reach2.41–2.45; the retained tenth ends3.201166. T256/b32 R endpoints are heterogeneous: first-table range2.4775–3.1232, second2.4308–3.0773. Late CE reductions and seed-sensitive high-loss endpoints are measured; their mechanism remains unresolved.

Competing explanations include optimizer/penalty trajectory effects, default initialization and layer-cloning interactions, finite-window generalization, calibration and token-conditioning learning. No train CE, true step0 CE, logits/probes, update norms or parameter-motion measurement is available. Near-lnV CE does not establish uniform logits or overshoot. Discriminating tests require train/test trajectories, conditioning probes, initialization-controlled repetitions and matched underlying-table alpha manipulation.

Intervals assume independent, approximately normal paired-seed differences, using t9 critical value2.262157. They omit multiplicity correction, held-out resampling and between-table uncertainty. Heterogeneous seed outcomes make n10 inference particularly fragile on bg_22dc04 and T256. Ratios divide means rather than averaging seed ratios.

Four independently materialized table/split instances were tested, all previously used for different recipes; no new datasets were materialized. There are only two tables per alpha. Alpha and table/split vary jointly. No transfer is established to other widths, FF, V/L, budgets, batches, losses, pre-LN, initialization or untuned rival rates.

Unmeasured prediction for alpha1.4 bg_96d120/bg_e30aa2: low-decay heads2/T512/b16 R loses to matched G3/W3; high-decay heads4/T512/b16 R beats G3/W3; high-decay heads2/T256/b32 R loses to W3. Reliable opposite paired signs reject these transfers. No universal heads2 high-decay victory is predicted.
